record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
BrowserGPT: Your Voice-Powered AI Browser Assistant for the Web

BrowserGPT is your intelligent AI co-pilot for navigating and managing the web, entirely hands-free. 

Designed to bring seamless voice & text-based interaction and intelligent automation to your browser, BrowserGPT transforms how you search, work, and interact online.


Whether you’re a busy professional, student, or accessibility user, BrowserGPT empowers you to control your browser with just your voice, remember key information, get real-time suggestions, and automate complex workflows effortlessly.



Key Features

Voice Command Assistant:

Say goodbye to clicks and typing. Open websites, search Google, fill forms, scroll pages, and manage tabs — all using voice commands. 

Just say, “Hi BrowserGPT,” and your assistant is ready to help.


SmartSense (Context-Aware Intelligence):

As you browse, BrowserGPT understands what’s on your screen and suggests helpful actions — like summarizing articles, autofilling forms, or navigating links.

Add to Memory:

Need to remember something for later? Just say it. Store facts, links, notes, and reminders instantly.


Browser Automation:

Instruct BrowserGPT to handle multi-step tasks like checking email, posting updates, or managing online tools — just by speaking.


Built-In Text Tools:

Quickly transform any text:

• Humanize AI-generated text
• Summarize long articles
• Fix grammar and punctuation
• Improve readability
• Detect AI-written content



Pricing Notice

BrowserGPT is free to try with limited usage.

All features require a paid subscription after the free usage limit is reached.



Accessibility-Friendly

Perfect for users with mobility challenges or visual impairments. Voice-first design makes it easy to use without touching your keyboard or mouse.


Private and Secure

We don’t store personal browsing history. Commands are processed securely.



Compatibility

• Available as a Chrome Extension (desktop)
• Mobile-compatible via WebView
• Requires microphone access for voice features



Transform the way you browse with voice and AI.

Try BrowserGPT for free — subscribe to unlock unlimited power.

• Explore dishes, prices, ingredients, and options

record.name: Document Voice - AI
record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Document Voice helps you scan, import, listen to, and understand documents with voice guidance—so letters, forms, reports, and PDFs are easier to follow without reading every line yourself.

Whether you are reviewing mail at home, checking paperwork at work, studying course material, or helping a family member with an unfamiliar document, Document Voice turns printed and digital pages into spoken guidance you can act on.

WHY DOCUMENT VOICE
Important documents often arrive in small print, dense language, or multiple pages. Document Voice is built for those moments. Capture a document with your camera, import a photo or PDF, and move from raw text to understanding with tools designed for listening, not just looking.

HOW IT WORKS

Scan or import a document from your camera, photo library, or PDF file.
Extract the text with on-device optical character recognition.
Hear it read aloud, get a summary and explanation, or ask a spoken question about what you captured.
Return anytime from scan history when you need to review a document again.
KEY FEATURES
• Scan documents with your camera
• Import photos and PDFs
• Read documents aloud
• Summarize and explain in plain language
• Ask questions with your voice
• Multi-page understanding
• Scan history stored on your device
• Spoken guidance and silenced mode
• Many interface languages, including English, Arabic, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Indonesian, Malay, Thai, Vietnamese, Hebrew, Ukrainian, Czech, Romanian, Hungarian, Greek, Persian, Urdu, and Bengali

BUILT FOR REAL DOCUMENT MOMENTS
At home: understand utility notices, insurance letters, school forms, and household paperwork with less stress.
At work: review reports, policies, and internal documents when you need the meaning quickly.
For study and accessibility: hear material aloud, summarize it, and ask follow-up questions when reading on screen is tiring or difficult.

FREE AND PRO
Document Voice is free to download and includes scanning, importing, reading aloud, and scan history.

Document Voice Pro unlocks AI-powered summaries, explanations, and document voice Q&A. Pro is available through monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions. You can restore purchases at any time.

Free users receive a limited number of AI analysis actions before Pro is required. Scanning, importing, and read-aloud features remain available outside those AI-powered actions.

PRIVACY AND CONTROL
Scan history and app preferences are stored on your device. You can delete history from within the app, manage permissions in system settings, and choose how much you rely on optional AI features.

Document Voice helps you understand documents more easily. It does not replace professional legal, medical, financial, or other specialist advice.

START WITH ONE DOCUMENT
Open Document Voice, scan or import a page, and hear what it says. When you need more than raw text, upgrade to Pro for summaries, explanations, and voice Q&A that help complex documents feel clearer, faster, and easier to use.

record.name: KernelAI - Offline AI Chat
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
ON-DEVICE AI

Downloaded compatible models run locally on your device. KernelAI checks model compatibility and memory needs before you download, so you can choose a model that fits your iPhone or iPad.

CHAT WITH DOCUMENTS

Ask questions about PDFs, DOCX, CSV, Markdown, and text files. Summarize, search, and find useful passages with on-device document chat.

UNDERSTAND IMAGES

Attach a photo, screenshot, chart, or diagram and ask what it shows with a compatible vision model. Image analysis runs on-device.

50+ MODEL OPTIONS

Choose from 50+ models, including Llama, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Phi, and more. Import compatible GGUF models from Files, URLs, or your local network.

WRITE, LEARN, AND CODE

Use local models for writing, brainstorming, explanations, and code. Generate, explain, and review code with models selected for programming.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR AI

Set a system prompt and generation parameters for each model. See tokens-per-second, context usage, and generated thinking output from supported reasoning models.

VOICE, SIRI, AND SHORTCUTS

Dictate prompts with voice input. Ask KernelAI from Siri or build it into Shortcuts on supported iOS versions. On supported iOS 26 devices, Apple's built-in on-device model can answer in the background; downloaded models may open KernelAI while they run.

ORGANIZE YOUR WORK

Keep conversations in folders, search your history, branch a chat, edit or regenerate messages, and export your work. Use KernelAI on iPhone and iPad, including from the Share Sheet and Home Screen widget.

OPTIONAL WEB SEARCH

Turn on web search when you need current information. Add your own Tavily or Exa API key; web search is off by default. Provider fees may apply.

TEN APP LANGUAGES

Use KernelAI in English, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese or Arabic. Choose your language during onboarding or change it in Settings. Arabic includes a right-to-left interface.

FREE TO USE

KernelAI remains free. Local AI works offline after downloading a compatible model. No subscription is required for this version.

Terms & Conditions: https://kernelai.app/terms

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Speech Central has been built for focused, serious reading since 2014. It works across PDFs, web articles, books, and documents.

Designed for productivity and accessibility, it combines powerful controls, deep customization, and seamless integration across Apple devices.

No subscription. A one-time upgrade unlocks unlimited use. Free access is available for blind users with VoiceOver and for schools deploying the app through Apple School Manager.


READING WITHOUT DISTRACTIONS

Optimized PDF & Web Reading
• Accurate reading order and navigation
• Optional cleanup to reduce distractions such as headers, footnotes, citations, and links
• RSS support and easy sharing from Safari and other apps

Broad Document Support
• PDF (including scanned PDFs with two-column layout)
• EPUB
• Word (.docx)
• PowerPoint (.pptx)
• OpenOffice formats
• HTML, TXT, RTF, Markdown, and more


VOICES: OFFLINE AND CLOUD AI

• Use high-quality Apple system voices offline
• Supports compatible system-wide voices from third-party apps, including offline neural voices from Piper - Neural TTS and ToBe SAID (Pocket TTS) apps
• Connect cloud AI voices (OpenAI-compatible APIs, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, xAI) using your own API keys
• Proprietary enhancement layer improves realism and streaming playback
• Optional AI summarization tools help you review content more efficiently


BUILT FOR THE APPLE ECOSYSTEM

• Sync reading position and playlists across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• CarPlay support for listening and control in your vehicle
• Independent Apple Watch app — listen without your iPhone nearby
• Optional Health integration to track mindful listening time


ACCESSIBILITY FIRST

• Dedicated profiles for ADHD, dyslexia, and low vision
• Interface and reading behavior adapt for reduced distraction and improved comprehension
• Fully accessible with VoiceOver


STUDY & KNOWLEDGE TOOLS

• Annotate while reading
• Export annotated text to .docx
• Export text to audio files for offline listening


PRIVACY BY DESIGN

• No ads
• No tracking
• No usage analytics


WHO USES SPEECH CENTRAL

• Students and researchers
• Professionals converting reading into listening time
• Users who rely on assistive reading tools
• Anyone who prefers distraction-reduced, hands-free reading

Notes:
- Free version limited by the number of daily articles; unlimited access available with Pro upgrade.
- Some features require the latest OS version.
- License is valid only on iOS/watchOS; separate licenses required for other platforms.
- DRM-protected books (e.g. Kindle) are incompatible.
- AI features may occasionally perform unexpectedly.

record.description_evidence:
ChatMCP bridges the gap between large language models (LLMs) and native iOS functionalities by implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP). This protocol standardizes the way AI models interact with external tools and data sources, enabling seamless integration and enhanced capabilities.

Key Features:
 • Local Tool Integration: Provides hardcoded tools that mirror iOS frameworks like EventKit and PhotoKit, allowing LLMs to access calendar events, photos, and more.
 • Remote Tool Connectivity: Connect to external MCP servers to extend functionality beyond local resources.
 • Secure and Standardized: Utilizes MCP’s open standard to ensure secure and consistent interactions between AI models and system services.
 • Customizable Extensions: Developers can add or modify tools to tailor the app’s capabilities to specific needs.

By leveraging MCP, ChatMCP transforms your iPhone into a powerful interface for AI models, enabling them to perform tasks that require direct interaction with system-level services.

record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Miles One – For the AI-Ready Accountant you’ll ever need

Miles One is the only app built to help accounting professionals become globally qualified and AI-ready. It brings together US CPA, US CMA, CAIRA (Certified AI Ready Accountant) and career opportunities in one integrated platform.
If your goal is to work at the Big 4, top MNCs, or even in the US, Miles One gives you a clear, structured pathway from learning to certification to jobs.

Become an AI-Ready Accountant
Accounting careers are evolving fast. Excel is no longer enough. Firms now expect accountants who can work with AI, analytics, automation, and intelligent workflows.
Miles One integrates CAIRA, India’s first NASBA-certified AI credential for accountants, directly into the CPA and CMA journey. CAIRA Level 1 is free for all Miles CPA and CMA candidates, helping you build AI skills from day one.
With CAIRA, you learn how to apply AI across audit, tax, FP&A, advisory, and controllership using tools already used in Big 4 and US firms, including Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, automation platforms, and GPT tools.

Choose Your Global Qualification
Miles One lets you pursue the qualification that fits your career goals.
The US CPA program prepares you for four online exams with a proven structure designed for working professionals. With an 82%+ pass rate, over 80% of CPAs in India today are Miles alumni.
The US CMA program focuses on management accounting, FP&A, and corporate finance. With just two exams, many candidates complete CMA in 8 to 12 months, supported by expert-led learning and structured study plans.
Both programs are designed to be completed alongside work, with guided mentorship and performance tracking inside the app.

Learn Smarter with AI-Powered Tools
Miles One combines expert teaching with technology-led learning.
Inside the app, candidates get interactive study material, real exam simulations, smart revision tools, and performance analytics that adapt to their progress. Live classes, recorded sessions, and masterclasses ensure concepts are not just learned, but applied.
The platform is built to help candidates study efficiently, stay consistent, and clear exams with confidence.

Jobs, Placements & Global Pathways
Clearing exams is only part of the journey. Miles One is designed to help candidates convert qualifications into real careers.
With CPA or CMA plus CAIRA, candidates gain access to roles at Big 4 firms, Fortune 500 companies, public accounting GCCs, and MNCs in India. Miles has a dedicated placement team supporting candidates across roles and industries.
For eligible candidates, the Miles US Pathway opens doors to public accounting roles in the United States, where demand for CPA and AI-ready professionals is high and salaries start at ₹50 lakhs and above.

A Global Community of 70,000+ Professionals
Miles One connects you to India’s largest CPA and CMA community.
Candidates gain access to webinars, expert panels, hiring insights, regulatory updates, and peer discussions. The app also supports CPE credits to help professionals maintain and grow their credentials throughout their careers.

Referral Program Now Live
Miles alumni can now earn rewards by referring friends through the Miles One app. For every successful CPA or CMA enrolment, you earn ₹5,000, with many alumni already earning significant monthly rewards.

Start Your Global Accounting Journey
Whether you are starting your CPA or CMA journey or upgrading your career with AI skills, Miles One gives you everything you need in one place.
Learn. Certify. Work globally.


Download Miles One and take the first step toward becoming a globally qualified, AI-ready accountant.

BookBI: Accounting, Simplified.


Designed for entrepreneurs, freelancers, and micro-businesses, BookBI is your smart, AI-powered accounting assistant — helping you manage your finances with zero accounting knowledge required.

With BookBI, you can:

•	Snap receipts and log expenses instantly
•	Issue invoices in seconds (VAT-compliant)
•	View real-time sales and expenses reports
•	Track what you owe and what you're owed
•	Stay ready for corporate tax with 1-click summaries

Use it anywhere, anytime.

Whether you’re closing a deal, on the road, or managing your cash flow at midnight, BookBI is available 24/7 — right in your pocket.


Instant Setup. Instant Insight.

No complex setup. No accounting jargon. Just your data, organized, categorized, and visualized — powered by advanced AI.


Made for the GCC region.


BookBI is fully compatible with UAE corporate tax and VAT regulations.



Key Features


Snap & Go Receipts
Take a photo — BookBI extracts and logs the details instantly.


Invoices in Seconds
Send professional invoices with tax calculations in under 11 seconds.

Net Position View
See your current profit/loss in real time.

Payables & Receivables
Track upcoming bills and outstanding client payments.

Monthly Reports
Get auto-generated monthly reports to stay audit- and tax-ready.


Built-in Currency Converter
Automatic conversion from AED to USD using daily updated rates as per UAE Central Bank.

record.name: Nume - Your AI CFO
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Nume is the AI CFO for businesses.

The iOS app is a companion to the Nume desktop app. Sign up and connect your accounting software and bank accounts on desktop, then use this app to access your AI CFO wherever you are. Ask any financial question in plain English and get specific, data-backed answers from your real books.

WHAT NUME DOES

Cash position and runway
Know exactly how much cash you have, how fast you're spending it, and how many months of runway you have left. Calculated daily from your actual bank and accounting data.

Expense tracking
See where your money is going. Nume flags anomalies, spots unused subscriptions, and highlights cost trends before they become problems.

Revenue analysis
Track revenue growth, monitor customer payments, and understand what's driving your top line, broken down by the segments that matter to your business.

Overdue invoices
Nume watches your accounts receivable, flags overdue invoices, and recommends follow-up actions so you collect what you're owed.

Reports you can share
Generate professional reports as PDFs or slides directly from a conversation. Share them with your team, investors, or board.

YOUR DATA, SECURED

Nume connects to your accounting and banking platforms through official, encrypted integrations. Your data is never shared with third parties. Every number is cross-checked against your source data.

Discover Fiskl: The All-In-One AI-powered Finance Management and Accounting App for Small Businesses 

*****Trusted by business owners in over 170 countries, Fiskl is your ultimate solution for managing your finances, saving you hours of reconciliation work, and making accounting a breeze.

◆ All-in-one feature set: Fiskl offers invoicing, expense management, time and mileage tracking, banking sync (with over 21,000 banks globally), products and services, and much more, all in one platform.

◆ Mobile-first: Experience full functionality on mobile devices, perfect for business owners and their teams who need finances on the go, with multi-user, role-based permissions.

◆ Best-in-class multi-currency: Seamlessly manage transactions in 168 currencies, with AI-powered reconciliation and matching of multi-currency internal transfers.

◆ Extensive range of payment integrations: Fiskl supports Stripe, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, iDeal, Chase/WePay, GoCardless, Bancontact, and more.

◆ Multi-language support: Fiskl supports over 60 languages for invoices and payments, ensuring smooth communication with clients and local tax authorities filings.

◆ AI-based accounting: Simplify accounting for non-accountants with Fiskl's intelligent, automated categorization, and dynamic ledger accounting.

◆ Global tax management & reporting: Stay compliant with built-in tax structures, agency numbers, and country-specific currency reporting.

◆ Suitable for various industries: Fiskl is designed for freelancers, startups, and small businesses across numerous sectors, from services to e-commerce to construction.

◆ Award-Winning Fintech: Europe Fintech Awards 2022 - Accounting Tech of the Year, No. 14 UK Fintech 50 2022, Visa Everywhere Europe 2021.

Join the thousands of small businesses that trust Fiskl for their financial management, and take control of your business finances today!
